name: catalog-1
request: Flatten catalog.json into catalog.csv with sku, name, category and price.

name: catalog-2
request: List the names of products under 40 dollars that are available, as cheap.json (a JSON array of names).

name: catalog-3
request: Average price per category, rounded to 2 decimals, as a bar chart; save category-prices.csv.

name: contacts-1
request: Remove duplicate contacts: treat emails as the same when they only differ in case or spaces, keep the first row. Save clean-contacts.csv.

name: contacts-2
request: Count how many unique contacts each company has (by email, ignoring case and spaces). Save per-company.json.

name: contacts-3
request: List the contacts with no phone number as missing-phone.csv with name and email, one row per person.

name: expenses-1
request: Sum spending by category and save by-category.csv, biggest first.

name: expenses-2
request: Total spending per month (YYYY-MM) as a line chart; save monthly.csv.

name: expenses-3
request: List every expense over 100 with its merchant, largest first, as big-spends.csv.

name: inventory-1
request: Which items are below their reorder point? Save low-stock.csv with sku, name and stock.

name: inventory-2
request: Total stock per supplier as a bar chart; save stock-by-supplier.csv.

name: inventory-3
request: Make reorder.csv for items below their reorder point with sku, supplier and order_qty = 2 times reorder_point minus stock.

name: orders-1
request: Total sales by item, as quantity times price. Save totals.json mapping each item to its total.

name: orders-2
request: Show total sales per region as a bar chart, and save region-sales.csv.

name: orders-3
request: Find the 3 items with the most revenue in March 2026 and save top-march.csv with item and revenue.

name: serverlog-1
request: Count the log lines per level (INFO, WARN, ERROR). Save levels.json.

name: serverlog-2
request: Extract every ERROR line into errors.csv with time, path and message.

name: serverlog-3
request: Which paths had warnings or errors, and how many of each? Save trouble.csv with path, level and count.

name: survey-1
request: Average satisfaction by age group, rounded to 1 decimal. Save satisfaction.csv in age group order.

name: survey-2
request: What share of respondents would recommend us? Save recommend.json as {"yes_percent": number} rounded to a whole number.

name: survey-3
request: Pull out the comments that mention price (any capitalization) with respondent and satisfaction. Save price-comments.csv.

name: tickets-1
request: Count the tickets that are not closed, by priority. Save open-by-priority.json.

name: tickets-2
request: For closed tickets, average the days from opened to closed per agent, rounded to 1 decimal. Save agent-speed.csv.

name: tickets-3
request: Which open or waiting tickets were opened on or before 2026-10-10? Save stale.csv sorted by opened date.
